# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: watchfulness comes first. A soldier who isn't alert is a soldier who gets ambushed. Before you can stand firm, you have to see the attack coming—the compromise at work, the temptation in private, the drift in your prayer life. Then comes the command to stand firm in the faith. Not in your feelings, not in your circumstances, not in your reputation—in the faith once delivered to the saints. The phrase "act like men" isn't about bravado; it's a call to maturity, to stop being tossed around by every wind of doctrine and every wave of emotion. And finally, "be strong"—not in yourself, but in the Lord and in the strength of His might. Real strength is never self-generated. It's borrowed from the One who conquered death. Today, you will face pressure. The question is whether you'll stand or shrink. Watch. Stand. Act like a man. Be strong.
## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and on each rep thank God that your strength comes from Him, not from yourself. Then spend two minutes in prayer asking Him to make you watchful today.
